name: Tucson
local_rules: Tucson has a 45-day window from the date of issuance to either pay or request a hearing. To contest by mail, you must submit a written 'Request for Hearing' at least 14 days before the appearance date shown on your ticket. Tucson City Court handles the adjudication, while Park Tucson handles the enforcement. If you are a student at the University of Arizona, UofA tickets are a separate system — do not mail city court for campus citations.
